students.title: EP：現在のNotion生徒キャッシュ
students.sql: SELECT id,student_number AS student_id,student_name AS name,status,contract_plan,synced_at FROM notion_students

progress.title: EP：レッスン別進捗の現在値（視聴イベント全履歴ではない）
progress.sql: SELECT p.id,ns.student_number AS student_id,u.name,p.lesson_id,p.completed,p.watch_percent,p.quiz_passed,p.quiz_attempts,p.last_watched_at,p.completed_at FROM user_progress p JOIN users u ON u.id=p.user_id AND u.role='生徒' LEFT JOIN student_profiles sp ON sp.user_id=u.id LEFT JOIN notion_students ns ON ns.notion_page_id=sp.notion_page_id

usage.title: EP：日本時間の日別アプリ利用回数
usage.sql: SELECT a.user_id,ns.student_number AS student_id,to_char(a.usage_date,'YYYY-MM-DD') AS usage_date,a.open_count,a.last_opened_at FROM app_usage_daily a JOIN users u ON u.id=a.user_id AND u.role='生徒' LEFT JOIN student_profiles sp ON sp.user_id=u.id LEFT JOIN notion_students ns ON ns.notion_page_id=sp.notion_page_id

surveys.title: EP：満足度回答（1〜5段階。中央管理の満足度とは別指標）
surveys.sql: SELECT s.id,ns.student_number AS student_id,to_char(s.survey_date,'YYYY-MM-DD') AS survey_date,s.overall_score,s.lesson_score,s.support_score,s.good_points,s.improvement_points,s.free_comment,s.wants_extension,s.created_at FROM satisfaction_surveys s JOIN users u ON u.id=s.student_user_id AND u.role='生徒' LEFT JOIN student_profiles sp ON sp.user_id=u.id LEFT JOIN notion_students ns ON ns.notion_page_id=sp.notion_page_id
